description: NaVO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ibam space group. Na is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.28 Å) and two longer (2.33 Å) Na-O bond lengths. V is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.83 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent V atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom.
